translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs Apuleng Ncblo Siu-nzlvqn (5,000)
Mz nibr kzdung mzli, nigr badr Jiszs prtzkr mz bot scgr, x sc tqalilvcopekr mz nrlarde kc Dxbu Gzlili. (Kzdq kz drtq dxbu lc Taebirizs.)

Vzdzpekr badr mz kzdq nra x sc tqwxbuo-lxblrpekr me mnzpz' mz nzalvztr-krde nigr. Mzli lc ycpe pipz nzkaputr-krm nzyrlwr-lxblrkr lr Jiu, kc tzrpibz Nzamyangr. X leplz kxnzkqlung sc tzyrkr-nqblqpelr Jiszs, murde nzmcpe-krdr rkx ngr nzamrlz-krde leplz kxnzyagoxng.
Kx mc Jiszs leplz kcng nzvz-krmlr bade, sc tqrpipebzle mz Filip kx, “?Myx me naxpe-ngrgu dakxnzng kx natakitrde zbo ngr leplz lc?”
(Krlc tqkxmu nzycmne-krbz Jiszs lc, murde na-abzle Filip mz nzkrlzpe-krde nike nartrngztibzle.)
Rpibz Filip kx, “Nzmu naxpeku dakxnzng, trau kxkqlu ela natwz, kx takitrde na-atatr-ngrm mz zbq kxtrtqki-li (200). Kxmule-esz' da pipzne lxblr kz badr, a' nzmu trnzyrkrpx-kz-ngrdru.”
Zbz kzdq nigr, drtqde Adru, mzle Saemon Pita, rpibzle mz Jiszs kx,
“Kzdq se doa ncblo kxtopwz mrlc twznede nade bret nzlvqn x nc kxtopwzne li. ?A' myx kxnamu nztakitr-krdr zbo ngr leplz lc?”

Mrkc tqmnco-ngrmgr lvcngr nabr, sc tqrpipem Jiszs bagr kx, “Pibzmu mz leplz nawxbuong.” Zbz leplz kcng sc tzwxbuopeng. X me ycngr nzrlwxngr ncblo krlzbzle siu-nzlvqn (5,000), a' trnzrlwxtrpwzu olvz x doa kxnztopwzng.
Jiszs kalzmle bret kcng, awitx-ngrbzle mz Gct, x sc tzakipebz mz leplz kcng tzwxbung. X waisr-kz-ngrde nc kcng. Nzmung amrlx ngrdr x nelzdr krlc, murde batrpz Gct nzkqlunepxkr dakxnzng kcng.
Leplz amrlx nelzdr kx krlc-lxblrpelr kc, sc tqrpipem Jiszs bagr kx, “Mikatiamu dakxnzng kcng tzmutrngr leplz lcng. Trmrlzu nzwztx-krdr brmrda.”
Ata-lxblrtikr x nulvzokr topla nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) mz nctq bret kx yctxong mz nzmukr leplz lcng.
Kx nzmclr rkx lc, leplz lcng sc tzrpipelr kx, “Zpwxtx, krlc Profet kc tqpi Gct navzm mz nrlc.”
X kx krlztipe Jiszs kx leplz sa nartulrtrpzlr nzngini-krde king, sc tqvzdzpe mou mz nra esz'-krde.
Jiszs Vzneom Mz Lue Ngr Dxbu Gzlili
Nrlc kx milzpqtrpzle kc, sc tqvzopekr esz'-krgr mz Dxbu Gzlili.
Prtzkr mz bot scgr, sc tqalilvckipekr mz nrlar dxbu kc, murde nakrlzbzkr taon Kzpznizm. Alilvckr, alilvckr x nrlc kc tqbqtxtrpe. A' Jiszs trkrlzkaple nigr.
Zbz nenq kc tqwqpe, x dcpwe kxtrka kc tqprtzpem. X sc tqavzopekr nqni scgr, murde nayapekr.
Sc tqyapekr, tqyapekr, x kx krlzpebzkr kc me tavau, sc tqmcpekr nzvz-krm kzdq ncblo mz lue. X kx esonetrple kc, sc tqmwxlr-zlwzpe-ngrgr nide.
A' krlc Jiszs. X rpimle bagr kx, “Ninge lc! Bzkq mwxlramu!”
X sc tqabrtzlvzpekr, sc tqaprtzpekr nide mz bot. Zbz pwrkilvc-ngrgr, murde sc tqkrlzpemgr mepz mz taon kc na-alilvckitrkr.
Jiszs Nide Dakxnzng Ngr Nzlungr

Nrlc kxngrlxobzle, zbo ngr leplz kcng tzyrlwrpe-moung mz nrlar dxbu. Kzdung bot ngr taon kxetu Taebirizs, sc tzdwa-aepztrpqng mrkc tzmu-ngrdr. X sc tzaenzli-moulr Jiszs, murde nzkrlzlr kx alilvco-lxblrmgr badr bq. X amnctxkr Jiszs x sc tqyzluopekr mz bot Kzpznizm.
X mzli kc tzkrlzpe-ngrdr trnzmncpe-kru Jiszs, x wai-kzle nigr ncblo nedeng, sc tzprtzpeng mz bot kcng, x sc tzalilvcopeng Kzpznizm, tzrtangrtipelr nide.
Kx nzkrlzobzlr kc Kzpznizm mz nrlar dxbu kc, sc tzrmctipelr Jiszs, x nzrpibzlr bade kx, “?Ei, Kxakrlz, myx kxmu nzvz-krme mrka?”

X sc tqalvztrpeng Jiszs mz mangr-nzkrka'ngr. Rpibzle badr kx, “Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Kc tqrtangrti-ngrnamu ninge ye, murde nzmu-krmu x drtwrmu esatxpx. A' trvz-ngrpwa'muu murde krlzamu drtwr ngr rkx kc tqaelwapx-ngrbo bamu.

Bzkq aotxtrpwz drtwrmu nzwz-kato-krmu mz nrlc ka mz nzrtwz-krmamu dakxnzng kx namibi. A' na-aoti drtwrmu nzwz-kato-krmu, mz nzrmcti-krmu dakxnzng kc narkabz bamu nzlungr kxboi. Dakxnzng lc nide kc nakabo bamu. Murde Gct aelwapx-angidr-ngrde kx aprcpemle zmatq ngrde bange.”
Zbz, sc tzveapebzng bade, nzrpibzlr kx, “?Nike nartrngztibzkr mz nzale-krgr nzwzkr Gct?”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Nzwzngr kx suti drtwr Gct nartrngztibzmu nide sele. Lxngitiamu ninge kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle.”
A' nzrpibzlr kx, “?Rkx kznike na-aelwapx-ngrme bagr murde nalxngitikr kx vzpxme mz Gct?
?Myx kxmule? ?Krlzq nzalengr rkx kcng tqale Mosis mzli kc melrmqgung tzmnc-ngrdr lzke, x nzmung dakxnzng kc tzrpibz mana? Murde Nzryrngrkxtr rpile kx, ‘Gct rkaom dakxnzng Heven kx nangqdr.’”
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Dakxnzng kc tqkabz Trtenge ngi dakxnzng angidr kx vzom Heven. A' trngiu dakxnzng lc tqkabz Mosis.
Murde dakxnzng angidr kc tqkapx Gct, tqvzom Heven mz nzrka-krbz nzlungr mz lr nrlc.”
Nzrpibzlr kx, “Kxetu, ka-zvzm bagr dakxnzng lc.”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Ninge dakxnzng ngr nzlungr. Doa kx vzm x lxngitile ninge trtxpengr nzbrtale-krde x nzbrlxkzkr drtwrde. Murde rkabo nzlungr kxmrna mz nabz leplz.
Kxmule-esz' mcpeamu mzke' a' trtxpnzngr nzlxngiti-krmu kx vzpxmc mz Gct.
Leplz amrlx kcng tqamnqtrp Trtenge bange, sa navzmqng bange. X krkcng tzvzmqng bange trtxpnzngr nzmaszlrpx-krngeleng. A' sa na-abrtzlvzx nidr.
Murde vzo-ngrmc Heven mz nzale-krnge me pnz drtwr Trtenge, a' trngiu da kx vzpxm mz drtwrnge esz'-krnge.
X me pnz drtwr Trtenge nide sele. Leplz kcng tqamnqtrple bange, trtxpnzngr nidr kx namrbrpxm. A' na-aclve-zpwxx nidr x na-atulz-mopwc'ng mz Mzli Kxmatq kc navzm.
Dazpwxtx, Trtenge suti drtwrde kx krkcng amrlx tzlxngitilr ninge narmctilr nzlungr kxboi, x na-atulz-mopwc'ng mz Mzli lc Tqmatq.”
Kxnzetu R Lr Jiu Nzrpwa'-ngrdr Jiszs
Kx nzxlrbz kxnzetu r lr Jiu nzycmne-krde lc, drtwrdr sc tqlcpe. Murde rpi Jiszs kx, “Ninge dakxnzng kc tqvzom Heven.”
X sc tzrpipelr kx, “Jiszs xke, Mrlx Josip. X krlz-angidrku trtede x lxede. ?A' nike tqrpi-ngrde kx, ‘Vzomc Heven?’”
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Bzkq drtwrmu lctrp mz natqnge lcng.
Trpnzngr kx navztxnem bange, a' ngi txpwz kx vectrp Trtenge. X leplz kxnzmulr lcng, sa na-atulz-mopwc'ng mz Mzli Kxmatq lc.

Mzli kc bqnc, leplz kcng tzvzmqng mz Gct, kxmu nzyrkr profet le nide sele. Nzrpilr kx, ‘Gct sa na-alvztrle leplz amrlx.’ X mzli ka, krkcng naxlrlr nzalvztrkr Trtenge x nzlxngitilr nide, sa navzmqng bange.
Mz nzalvztrkr Gct leplz, trngiu drtwr ngrde kx leplz nzmcpelr Gct mz mztr. Trtingr, a' nginitxpo kx vzpxm bade x mc-txpwzle nide.
Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Doa kx lxngitile ninge, rmctile nzlungr kxboi.
Ninge dakxnzng ngr nzlungr.
Mzli kc bqnc, melrmqgung tzmnc-ngrdr lzke, nzmung mana. X kxmule-esz' nzmung mana kc tqvzom wq, a' nzbzngr sa tqvz zvz.
A' mzli ka, dakxnzng angidr kc tqvzom Heven blepxngr. Murde doa kx namu dakxnzng lcde, trtxpnzngr nzbz-krde.
X ninge dakxnzng kxlu, kc tqvzom Heven. Doa kx ngqde dakxnzng lc, sa nalu-zvzpe. Murde dakxnzng lc ngi ncvrnge, x rlrpx-lzbq-ngrne mz nzalu-krnge lr nrlc.”
X lr Jiu kcng drtwrdr kc tqtrkape. X sc tzrpipelr kx, “?Myx kxnamu, nzka-krm mrlx lc ncvr drtqde mz nzngq-krgule?”
Zbz sc tqrpipebz Jiszs badr kx, “Da angidrtx lc napibo bamu. Ninge Mrlx Leplz. Nzmu trnangqwamuu ncvrnge x trnamnqwamuu mepyr rnge, trtxpnzngr nzlu-krmu.
A' doa kx ngqde ncvrnge x mnqle mepyr rnge, rmctile nzlungr kxboi x sa na-atulz-mopwc' mz Mzli Kxmatq kc navzm.
X sa nalu-mou, murde ncvr drtqnge ngi dakxnzng angidr, x mepyr rnge ngi da kx nzmnq angidr.
X doa kx ngqde ncvrnge x mnqle mepyr rnge, mncpxm bange x mncpebo bade.
Trtenge kc tqatwzlr-ngrmle ninge, nide nou nzlungr. X ni-kznge nzlungr, murde vzpxmc bade. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, doa kx ngqde ncvr drtqnge, sa nalu murde ninge nzlungr.
“Napi-mopwc' bamu kx ncvrnge ngi dakxnzng kx vzom Heven. Dakxnzng lc trapuleu mana kc tzngq melrmqgung lzke, x nzbzngr sa tqvz zvz. A' doa kx namu dakxnzng angidr lc, rmctile nzlungr kxboi.”
Nzalvztrkr Jiszs lc, ycmne mz mangr-nzkrka'ngr mrkc Kzpznizm.
Leplz Nzkqlung Nzvecpx-lzbqmqng Mz Jiszs
Kx nzxlr leplz kxnzvz-nqblqlr nide nzycmne-krde lc, sc tzrpipelr kx, “Nzalvztrngr lc rblxm bagu. ?Myx kxnamu nzkrlz-krgu natq lcng?”
Krlzpe Jiszs kx drtwrdr lctrpz mz nzalvztrngr lc. X sc tqrpipebzle kx, “?Myx kxmule, natqnge lcng nzataolr nimu mz nzlxngiti-krmu ninge?
?X nzmu namcamu ninge, nzyzlulz-krnge Heven mrkc tqrkakilzmc, mzli kc tqvzo-ngrmc? ?Nike napnz drtwrmu mzli lcde?
Murde natq kcng tqpibo bamu, nidr kcng tqrkabz nzlungr kc tqvzpxm mz Mqngrkxtr mz nabzmu. A' zmatq ngr leplz trtakitrde nzokatrngr nimu.

A' kzdung nimu trnzlxngiti-angidrlru natqnge. Delc tqrpi-pnz-ngrbo bamu kx, ‘Trpnzngr doa kx navztxnem bange, a' ngi txpwz kx rlr-ngrm x kam Trtenge.’” Jiszs kc tqkxmu nzycmne-krde lc, murde krlz-pnz-kaile mz nzabzokr nzwz-krde, doa kx na-amwale nide x krkcng trnalxngitilru nide.
Mzli lcde, leplz nzkqlung kx nzvecpx-lzbqpeng mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr nide.
Ncblo Neng Jiszs Tzvz-nqblq-zvzpelr Nide
Sc tqrpipe-kzp Jiszs bagr, nigr ncblo kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) kx, “?Myx kxmule mz nimu, suti kz drtwrmu nzrlasz-krmu ninge?”
A' rpibz Saemon Pita bade kx, “?Kxetu Lod, ncblo kznike navz-nqblq-moukr? Murde nim me vzkipxm natq ngr nzlungr.
X mzli ka lxngiti-angidrpekr kx nim Ncblo Kxtr kc esz'txu, tqatwzlr-ngrm Gct.”
Rpim Jiszs bagr kx, “Kxmule-esz' mcpxx nimu mz nzmnctr-krmamu bange, a' kzdq nimu ngi kxnzawz ne Setzn.”
Krlc tqycmnetr-ngrde Judzs, mrlx Saemon Iskariot, kc na-amwale nide.
